dialogue.speaker: Ruslan
dialogue.text: Nurgul, what's on the menu today? I can't read the board from here.

dialogue.speaker: Nurgul
dialogue.text: Let me see — there's some chicken soup, some rice with beef, and some pasta with vegetables.

dialogue.speaker: Ruslan
dialogue.text: Pasta with vegetables — perfect for me! Is there any salad today?

dialogue.speaker: Nurgul
dialogue.text: Yes! There's some tomato salad and some cucumber salad. And some fresh compote.

dialogue.speaker: Ruslan
dialogue.text: Great. I don't want any meat today. What are you having, Nurgul?

dialogue.speaker: Nurgul
dialogue.text: I always start with some soup. The chicken soup here is so delicious!

dialogue.speaker: Ruslan
dialogue.text: Is it spicy? I can't eat any spicy food — it upsets my stomach.

dialogue.speaker: Nurgul
dialogue.text: No, it's very mild. No chilli, no pepper. Everyone can eat it!

dialogue.speaker: Ruslan
dialogue.text: Good to know. Is there any bread today? I need some bread with my pasta.

dialogue.speaker: Nurgul
dialogue.text: Yes — some fresh white bread at the counter. And — wait — some baursaks too!

dialogue.speaker: Ruslan
dialogue.text: Baursaks! I love them. Do you want some water or some compote?

dialogue.speaker: Nurgul
dialogue.text: Compote please! I drink some compote with every lunch. You?

dialogue.speaker: Ruslan
dialogue.text: Just some water for me — compote is too sweet. I prefer something plain.

dialogue.speaker: Nurgul
dialogue.text: Ha! Different tastes! What food do you miss most from home, Ruslan?

dialogue.speaker: Ruslan
dialogue.text: My grandmother's samsa from Semey. Crispy pastry, juicy meat inside. Nothing beats it!

dialogue.speaker: Nurgul
dialogue.text: For me it's my mother's plov — with some carrots, some raisins, and some lamb. Heavenly!

task1Items.question: There is some chicken soup on the menu today.
Ruslan wants some meat for his lunch.
The chicken soup is spicy and has a lot of chilli.
Ruslan drinks compote because he loves sweet drinks.
There are some baursaks available at the counter today.
Nurgul misses her mother's plov with carrots, raisins, and lamb.
